messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["may reduce dose after adding diuretic", "doctor may reduce dose as condition improves", "diuretic", "drug interactions may reduce effectiveness", "reduce dose if not tolerated", "adjust diuretic dose to minimize hypovolemia", "potassium-sparing diuretic", "loop diuretic", "reduce inflammation", "maintenance dose may need to increase after surgery", "reduce dosage after adequate response has been reached", "reduce dose to 1.7 mg once weekly", "used with diuretic", "doctor may increase dose after several weeks if needed", "gradually reduce dosage", "after dose is lowered"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
